subject.title: feat(fleet): harden create, port allocation, drift visibility, and operator docs

question: Should Fleet retain an unhealthy created cell and treat non-EADDRINUSE loopback probe failures as advisory before the container runtime’s authoritative bind?
rationale: Those choices affect cleanup expectations and the host/container-runtime boundary; source review can verify implementation consistency but cannot select the permanent Fleet policy.

options.title: Accept documented semantics
options.body: Keep retained diagnostic evidence and advisory probing, with focused live runtime proof before merge.

options.title: Fail closed on probe errors
options.body: Reject creation whenever the CLI cannot successfully probe-bind the port, accepting incompatibility with some rootful runtime cases.

options.title: Remove pre-bind probing
options.body: Leave port conflicts to Docker or Podman and retain only health-gated creation and drift visibility.

recommendation.title: Accept documented semantics
recommendation.body: Keep retained diagnostic evidence and advisory probing, with focused live runtime proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The Fleet implementation and recent lifecycle-hardening history center on this owner.
